Beetlejuice.name: Beetlejuice: Horrific Hijinx from the Neitherworld!
Beetlejuice.summary:
Beetlejuice: Horrific Hijinx from the Neitherworld! is a video game created by Rare and published by Acclaim Entertainment for the Nintendo Game Boy in 1992. It is based on the Beetlejuice animated television series.

The game begins with the player taking control of Beetlejuice as he attempts to get rid of all the ghosts that he invited into Lydia Deetz's house (where she lives with her father and step-mother). He must rescue Lydia from the evil Astoroth. Using bio-exorcist magic, players must defeat undead creatures through the cemetery and inside the Neitherworld.

Binding of Isaac, The - Game Boy Edition.name: The Binding of Isaac: Game Boy Edition
Binding of Isaac, The - Game Boy Edition.summary: A demake for the classic roguelike The Binding of Isaac originally developed by Edmund McMillen and Florian Himsl. This homebrew redesign of the game was built from the ground up to run on the original Game Boy hardware itself (meaning it will require an emulator to play on the PC).

GameBoy WORDLE.name: GameBoy Wordle
GameBoy WORDLE.summary: GameBoy Wordle is a word puzzle homebrew game for the Game Boy.

Spot - The Cool Adventure.name: Spot: The Cool Adventure
Spot - The Cool Adventure.summary: Another game based on the adventures of 7-UP's mascot, Spot. Known in Europe as McDonaldland.

Tiny Toon Adventures.name: Tiny Toon Adventures: Wacky Sports
Tiny Toon Adventures.summary:
Tiny Toon Adventures: Wacky Sports (Tiny Toon Adventures 3: Doki Doki Sports Festival in Japan), released in 1994 on the Nintendo Game Boy and developed and published by Konami, is the third Tiny Toon Adventures-related game for the system.

The player chooses either Buster Bunny or Babs Bunny and participates in their choice of sports activities, including baseball, soccer, or tennis. As Buster, they can also play carnival games set up by characters such as Shirley the Loon and Fifi La Fume. Carnival games include a watergun gallery and a beat-the-clock challenge featuring Elmyra Duff.
